items.a: Andrej Karpathy coined it **Feb 3 2025**: fully give into the vibes, embrace exponentials, **forget that the code even exists**. Tina's course teaches principles that transfer across Replit, Windsurf, or Cursor.

items.q: What five skills make vibe coding work?
items.a: **TFCDC**: Thinking, Frameworks, Checkpoints, Debugging, Context — from the free **Vibe Coding 101 with Replit** (Replit × DeepLearning.AI).

items.q: Why write a PRD before prompting?
items.a: Most vibe coders **under-specify**. Map four thinking levels into a PRD: **logical** (what), **analytical** (how/goal), **computational** (features/rules), **procedural** (how to excel) — then convert PRD + mockup into the build prompt.

items.q: How do you keep scope sane?
items.a: Drop nice-to-haves; add **measurable features** (e.g. SEO score out of 100). **MVP first** — lavish multi-feature specs cause errors; ship core, then iterate.

items.q: How should you use frameworks with AI?
items.a: **Name stacks** (React, Tailwind, Three.js) so the model follows proven patterns; ask AI to recommend if unsure — still learn frontend/backend structure.
**Git + GitHub**: init → add → commit → push. Natural-language git commands are OK ("commit and push to main"); commit often.

items.q: What makes debugging work with agents?
items.a: Methodical identify → fix cycles; paste **full errors and screenshots**. File-structure literacy helps when the AI loops. Change **one thing at a time**, not a laundry list.

items.q: Replit vs Cursor/Windsurf for the same SEO MVP?
items.a: **Replit**: fast cloud, built-in rollback, QR mobile test. **Cursor/Windsurf**: slower local setup, more control, git required — often closer to mockup on first pass. Tradeoff: **speed vs scalability**.

items.q: What are the two vibe-coding modes?
items.a: **Feature implementation**: frameworks, docs, incremental changes, checkpoints. **Error debugging**: understand structure, feed errors/screenshots/file hints — different context strategies.

items.q: What belongs in agent rules files?
items.a: Limit **diff scope**, rate-limit APIs, **captcha on auth**, don't expose API keys; import community rules per stack.
